questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the repository records for the Jira issue, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff meets every part of R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT. PriceLines takes 5% off each line with 10 or more units. Integer division rounds each line's discount down separately, so a 0.10 line gets zero off. The discount code is then applied to the subtotal minus the volume discount, so the volume discount comes first. The combined discount is capped at MaxDiscountPercent of the original subtotal, so the volume discount counts toward the 50% cap. The cap only runs when a code is present, but the volume discount alone can never pass 5%, so that doesn't break the rule. PlaceOrder in checkout now uses PriceLines. New tests annotated with @req R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT check: the 10-unit threshold (a 9-unit line gets nothing), per-line rounding, the volume discount together with a code, the cap case, and the end-to-end checkout path.

finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-57. Checkout now applies a 5% discount to each cart line with at least 10 units, rounded down per line, before applying a discount code. The combined discount is capped at 50% of the original subtotal.

I added pricing and checkout tests and linked the implementation in [REQUIREMENTS.md](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.none.go-shop.T5.1/repo/REQUIREMENTS.md). `go test ./...` passes.
